title: Lost Mary Airplane Mode Strawberry Nic Film - 2mg/ Strip - 20pk
description: Lost Mary Airplane Mode Nicotine Films offer a clean, discreet way to enjoy nicotine with no tobacco, smoke or vapour. The Strawberry flavour delivers a fruity burst with a soft, sweet edge, making it an easy and enjoyable option. Each ultra-thin film is designed to dissolve comfortably under the lip, providing up to 20 minutes of steady nicotine release. With no odour, stains or mess, these films are ideal for use at work, during travel or on social occasions. To use, place one strip directly on to your tongue and let it dissolve over time. It will dissolve gradually and completely. Discard packaging responsibly after use. How to Use: Nicotine Strips Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow these pouches – they’re only designed to be placed behind your top lip.
